coverage: Field notebook in-app voice recording with an injected MediaRecorder and microphone: 24 kbps, 1-second slices, Stop queues a voice note with the plain audio type and releases the microphone, 60-second and size-limit auto-stops, lock discards a recording and releases the microphone, refusals for denied permission, unsupported browser and synced drafts. Real microphone capture is covered by the browser check only.
